mapper.select: SELECT receipt.id AS receipt_id, receipt.purchase_id, DATE(receipt.receipt_time) AS actual_date, DATE(purchase.expected_date) AS expected_date FROM biz_purchase_receipt receipt JOIN biz_purchase_request purchase ON purchase.id = receipt.purchase_id AND purchase.tenant_id = receipt.tenant_id WHERE receipt.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND purchase.supplier_id = #{supplierId} AND purchase.deleted = 0 AND purchase.expected_date IS NOT NULL AND receipt.received_quantity > 0 AND receipt.receipt_time >= #{from} AND receipt.receipt_time < DATE_ADD(#{to}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) ORDER BY receipt.id
